written.headline: Nvidia vera cpu offers higher agent throughput and better power efficiency
written.summary: Nvidia announced its Vera CPU can run AI agents faster while using less power than leading x86 CPUs. Early partners such as Perplexity, DeepInfra and others reported 1.5‑2.2× speed gains and up to 1.6× more agents per watt.
